item.title: Pony.ai unveils autonomous electric truck for logistics fleets
item.description:
Pony.ai has unveiled an autonomous electric truck for logistics fleets, developed with GAC Commercial Vehicle for freight supply chains. Unveiled at IAA Transportation 2026, this Level 4 (L4) heavy rig marks the fourth-generation (Gen-4) iteration of Pony.ai’s Robotruck platform. It builds on GAC Commercial Vehicle’s T9 battery-electric truck architecture, with mass production set to start […]

item.title: What must happen for AI's trillion-dollar gamble to pay off
Crypto's Biggest Week Ever? AI Swarm Fears Put the Market on Alert
Should AI friendliness be a priority for your projects?
item.description:
Recently I came up with an idea that if MCP server and AI focused readme is reasonable for your project than it must be done.

Take for example my API mocking/prototyping server "Apate" (github.com/rustrum/apate). 1 year ago I never thought about AI as a main consumer of this tool. So it was focused mostly on smart human developers. But now I'm starting to think that developers should not be bothered with such stuff at all. It's up to AI to write mocking API DSL on fly while it's developing main app that should consume this API.
